source.instrument: Coilcraft's four-port measurement of the JA4220-AL (0.1-8500 MHz, fixture de-embedded, 50 ohm ports, pin 3 grounded); detector pulse: LeCroy WavePro 740Zi

caveats: Measured by the manufacturer, not on this instrument: Coilcraft's four-port data, fixture de-embedded, 50 ohm on every port. The part as fitted sees the detector's source impedance, which is not 50 ohm, so its low-frequency corner in the instrument may differ.

The data are the grounds-tied case (pin 3 grounded, every port sharing one reference). The galvanically isolated case cannot be recovered from them, so the common-mode rejection shown (about 20 dB) is the pessimistic figure.
Single-ended responses are obtained by shorting the unused winding ends and reducing the four-port, as the part is wired; this is not the mixed-mode Sdd21, which understates the loss.
The pulse panel applies the measured magnitude response (zero phase) to the mean measured single-ion pulse; it is a calculation from measured data, not a capture through the part.
